proposals: The Petroleum Ministry should publish, with each revision of the EBP procurement price, a comparison against US Gulf and Brazilian Santos ethanol benchmarks, so that the gap between about $0.72 per litre paid domestically and $0.45–0.61 on world markets is stated by the buyer itself.

DGFT should publish the number, volume and destination of second-generation ethanol export authorisations granted since September 2025, so that it is visible whether the restricted 2G export window is used at all.

DGCI&S should report exports of extra-neutral alcohol and fuel ethanol under separate published lines with destination detail, so that growing ENA shipments to West Africa are not read as a fuel-ethanol export market that does not yet legally exist.

The Department of Food and Public Distribution should publish distillery capacity utilisation, plant by plant, for each ethanol supply year, so that the roughly 57% utilisation on about 2,100 crore litres is tracked and idle capacity can be identified for other uses.
